flashcards.back:
• `-e`: Abort script if any command fails (non-zero status)
• `-u`: Abort if an uninitialized variable is referenced
• `-o pipefail`: Pipeline returns failure status if ANY command in the pipeline fails

interviewQuestions.question: Write a script to check if a web service is healthy and restart it if down.
interviewQuestions.modelAnswer:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

URL="http://localhost:8080/health"

if ! curl -sf "$URL" > /dev/null; then
  echo "[$(date)] Service down! Restarting..." >> /var/log/monitor.log
  systemctl restart my-webserver
fi
keyPoints: curl -sf flag for quiet error checking
